title: eludite.editor.apply_code_action output
description: What applying the action did. From the UI thread the state is usually `resolving`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the outcome.

state.description: `resolving`: waiting for codeAction/resolve; `applying`: closed files are being written; `applied`: done (see `summary`); `expanded`: the action's nested actions are shown; `unsupported`: the action is a command Eludite cannot run; `failed`: the request failed or the edit was refused.

summary.description: What the workspace-edit applier did (the same shape as the eludite.workspace.apply_edit output without `state`).

applied.description: True when every change was applied; false when the edit was refused (nothing was applied) or a write failed (see `message`).

files.description: Distinct files touched (edited, created, renamed or deleted).

open_documents.description: Open documents edited in their buffers (one undo step each, not saved).

files_on_disk.description: Closed files written on disk (atomically: a temporary file, then a rename).

paths.description: The absolute paths touched, sorted (at most 1000).

message.description: Why the edit was refused or failed.
